summary: Tested the NEW image-generation flow for density suggestions. Backend endpoint POST /api/density/generate-image is FULLY WORKING (6/6 pytest assertions pass, including auth guards, validation, cross-tenant 403, happy-path with a real 60KB JPEG, and idempotent deterministic filename). Frontend smoke (slide 1 Capa) renders correctly. HOWEVER, the PRIMARY frontend E2E (clicking 'Aplicar' on an 'Inclui imagem' suggestion in the editor) FAILS: image generation is NEVER triggered. Network trace shows zero calls to /api/density/generate-image even though the user-facing 'Inclui imagem' badge is present on all three suggestions. RCA: SlideProperties.jsx reads `project?.projectId`, but the Editor passes `project={currentProject}` and currentProject's id field is `.id` (used by ~30 other call sites in Editor.jsx). The guard `if (sug.requiresImage && sug.imagePrompt && project?.projectId)` is therefore ALWAYS false → fetch never fires → slide receives text-only apply at full canvas width and no image. This is the exact regression the iteration was supposed to fix.

ui_bugs.issue: Image generation never fires for requiresImage suggestions. The slide ends up text-only at full-width — identical to the pre-fix buggy behaviour the user reported. ROOT CAUSE: lines 345 and 356 reference `project?.projectId` / `project.projectId`, but the parent Editor.jsx (line 1706) passes `project={currentProject}` and currentProject uses `.id` (verified against 30+ other usages in Editor.jsx: lines 405, 411, 464, 467, 472, 543, 546, etc.). One-line fix: change `project?.projectId` -> `project?.id || project?.projectId` (and same on the body payload). After the fix, the spinner should appear for ~15-25s and the slide should split 55/43 text+image.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend never invokes the new backend endpoint because of the projectId field mismatch above. Confirmed by network capture during E2E: only /api/density/suggestions (200) was called; no /api/density/generate-image request appeared. Toast text was empty (the success/failure branch with the image message was never reached because htmlElements update completed before any awaited fetch).

action_items: CRITICAL P0: Fix SlideProperties.jsx lines 345 and 356 to use the correct project id field. The Editor passes `currentProject` which exposes `.id`; the new code expects `.projectId` (which is GeneratedPanel.jsx's shape, where project comes from /api/agent endpoints). Minimal patch: replace `project?.projectId` with `(project?.id || project?.projectId)` in both the guard condition and the fetch body. Without this, the entire image-generation feature is unreachable from the editor.

After the fix, re-run the E2E: select slide-8 -> click density-analyze-button -> wait for suggestions -> click density-apply-0 (Pilares dos Controles Internos, type=infografico) -> button should spin ~15-25s -> slide should have BOTH a text element (left ~55%) AND an image element (right ~43%) with src starting with /api/projects/.../assets/density_img_*.jpg. Backend log should show '[gemini-image]' lines.

Optional cleanup: extract the duplicated apply logic (SlideProperties.jsx 327-487 and GeneratedPanel.jsx 434-590) into a shared hook/util — this exact field-name drift would have been caught by a single source of truth.

rca of the issue: Field-name mismatch between two prop-shape conventions. Agent flow (/api/agent/projects) returns objects with .projectId; the editor flow (/api/projects/{id}) returns objects with .id. SlideProperties.jsx was authored against the agent-flow shape (matching GeneratedPanel.jsx) but is actually mounted from the editor flow. The truthy-guard short-circuits, no fetch fires, and the apply silently degrades to text-only without any error log — making the bug hard to spot in dev tools. Reproduction: clear, every time. Mitigation: `project?.id || project?.projectId` in the two references on lines 345 & 356 of SlideProperties.jsx.
